blocks.text: Vilma Santos will receive a special tribute from Edgar “Bobot” Mortiz and Tirso Cruz III who are set to serenade her at the 42nd PMPC Star Awards for Movies. Mortiz, Santos’ former onscreen leading man, and Cruz, her close friend, will perform a special number in honor of the veteran actress, who will make history as the first actress to be inducted into the Philippine Movie Press Club (PMPC) Star Awards for Movies Hall of Fame in the Movie Actress of the Year category. Santos, popularly known as the “Star for All Seasons,” is among this year’s Hall of Fame inductees, […]...
